name: CloudJiffy

evidence.paas: 03: hosted container PaaS; the provider manages the platform and the customer deploys apps
evidence.vps: 03: optional Elastic VPS with root SSH access, which the customer maintains

line: Deploy web apps on a managed container platform.

free.text: 14-day trial: 2 environments, 12 cloudlets/node; no IP, Docker or .NET

work.math: Subtotals for 2 cloudlets (CloudJiffy's resource units) plus an IP address: India $3.21857, USA $3.54999, Germany $4.9932. How much build resource and hourly traffic is used is unknown.
Subtotals for 9 cloudlets plus an IP address: India $9.0593, USA $10.55069, Germany $15.4687. The docs conflict on how cloudlets map to CPU cores.
Subtotals for 18 cloudlets (app plus database): India $16.24031, USA $18.76319, Germany $28.9372. Backup storage, traffic and build charges are unknown.
